[[File:Deep_woods_poachers.jpg|thumb|200px|An [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] and an [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] deep woods poacher]]
The '''deep woods poachers''' were a group of poachers that illegally hunted the local wildlife on the [[Rryatt Trail]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They mainly operated on the [[Rryatt Trail#Wroshyr Canopy|Wroshyr Canopy]] part of the trail.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] [[Tressk]] paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate these poachers.
